design_addendum.owner: Authorize one new unique task-named m80_beta_access_owner_<suffix> NOLOGIN/NOSUPERUSER/NOINHERIT/NOCREATEDB/NOCREATEROLE/NOREPLICATION/NOBYPASSRLS role per new synthetic fixture, without role membership in either direction. No existing role changes.
design_addendum.objects: Transfer only new beta schema, eight tables and three public entrypoints to new owner. Two internal cross-boundary helpers stay exact existing operator-owned and PUBLIC-revoked; only new beta owner receives their EXECUTE. Refactor identity helper to obtain the authoritative actor itself and return the locked identity; new entrypoints need no direct auth/neuvetra privileges.
design_addendum.defaults: Only new owner receives global default function PUBLIC EXECUTE revocation. Supported future creation uses SET LOCAL ROLE new owner. Current/operator/legacy defaults unchanged; schema-only revocation is ineffective. An operator superuser remains trusted and can bypass ACLs; this is not a defense against a malicious superuser.
design_addendum.validation: Exact install replay/readiness must enforce owner identity/flags/membership/default ACL, schema/table/function owners, private helper grants and only three runtime entrypoints. Fail closed on drift. New-owner future helper must be runtime-inaccessible. Prove existing legacy rows/catalog/roles/defaults unchanged; explicitly classify only new role/new beta objects.
design_addendum.transport: Bounded cancel at over2048 bytes and decorated413 with Connection close; never unbounded drain. Prove raw connection closes and the next client request reconnects to normal403 with headers/log, with exact2048/2049/multibyte tests. Listener cap above tested application boundary. Hosted proxy/listener limits remain untested.
